item.title: Beckman Coulter, Inc.: DxU 840m Iris, REF: C76947; DxU 850m Iris, REF: C49513 Recall
item.product: DxU 840m Iris, REF: C76947; DxU 850m Iris, REF: C49513
item.summary: The rinse-line check valve has a shorter service lifespan than originally expected and requires annual replacement to prevent lamina fluid leakage; however, the check valve replacement was excluded from the annual preventive maintenance (PM) requirements without adequate reliability evaluation. When the check valve is not replaced annually, it may allow lamina fluid to migrate internally and leak onto the table or floor, potentially resulting in exposure to physical hazards (slip/fall), chemical hazards (lamina fluid exposure), biohazardous exposure, property damage, and delayed patient results. Product details: DxU 840m Iris, REF: C76947; DxU 850m Iris, REF: C49513
